terms.comment: The modern name declined in Latin (medieval Sintria).

Given as the ancient name of the Sintra hills, but we have not found it in the Latin texts we hold (Pliny, Mela and the Latin Library), nor in the pages of Graesse we could read; so it is labelled post-classical until a source turns up.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
